articles.summary: Respite care services in Ohio can give family caregivers the break they need—without sacrificing safety or quality of care. This guide covers in-home respite, adult day services, and overnight options, plus how Medicaid waivers and other programs may help pay. Learn where to start, what to ask for, and how to connect with your local Area Agency on Aging.
articles.title: Finding Respite Care in Ohio: A Complete Guide for Family Caregivers

articles.summary: If you're caring for a parent or loved one at home, developing specific caregiving skills can make a significant difference in both safety and quality of care. These five foundational competencies keep your loved one safer, protect you from injury and burnout, and ensure you're providing the level of care they need. Whether you're exploring paid caregiving programs in Ohio or simply want to improve your caregiving approach, mastering these skills is essential.
articles.title: 5 Essential Skills Every Family Caregiver Needs to Learn

articles.summary: Whether you’re a senior living independently or a family member caring for an older loved one, creating a safe and comfortable home is one of the most important ways to protect independence and peace of mind. It’s essential to reduce fall risks and consider age‑related changes—such as vision, balance, and memory—when setting up each space. With a few thoughtful adjustments, we can make everyday life easier, safer, and more enjoyable. At CareOasis, we believe every older adult deserves the chance to age gracefully at home. A safe home is the foundation for that independence.
articles.title: 2026 Ohio Home Safety Checklist: Get Up to $15,000 in Waiver Support
